scope: Global employer expectations; not a Malaysia-specific measurement
source: World Economic Forum, The Future of Jobs Report 2025 — Skills Outlook
extraction_note: Directions are employer expectations reported by WEF, not observed Malaysian demand. The report does not publish a comparable per-skill percentage for most entries. Mapped skills are explicit prototype taxonomy proxies and do not claim equivalence.
scoring_note: Qualitative rising/stable/declining directions use a fixed ±0.7/0.0 score signal; this is a ranking heuristic, not a WEF statistic.

skill_signals.mapping_note: The app uses machine learning as a proxy for this broader WEF skill group.
skill_signals.mapping_note_zh: 应用以“机器学习”作为 WEF 更广泛技能类别的匹配代理。
skill_signals.mapping_note_ms: Aplikasi menggunakan pembelajaran mesin sebagai proksi bagi kategori kemahiran WEF yang lebih luas.
skill_signals.evidence: WEF reports AI and big data among the fastest-growing skills expected through 2030.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 报告将 AI 与大数据列为预计到 2030 年增长最快的技能之一。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF meletakkan AI dan data raya antara kemahiran yang dijangka berkembang paling pantas hingga 2030.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF expects networks and cybersecurity skills to rise in importance through 2030.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 预计网络与网络安全技能的重要性到 2030 年将继续上升。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF menjangka kepentingan rangkaian dan keselamatan siber meningkat hingga 2030.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF expects technological literacy to rise in importance through 2030.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 预计技术素养的重要性到 2030 年将继续上升。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF menjangka literasi teknologi semakin penting hingga 2030.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF expects creative thinking to rise in importance through 2030.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 预计创造性思维的重要性到 2030 年将继续上升。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF menjangka pemikiran kreatif semakin penting hingga 2030.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF expects resilience, flexibility and agility to rise in importance through 2030.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 预计韧性、灵活性与敏捷性到 2030 年将更加重要。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF menjangka daya tahan, fleksibiliti dan ketangkasan semakin penting hingga 2030.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF lists service orientation and customer service among core skills expected to remain relatively stable.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 将服务意识与客户服务列为预计保持相对稳定的核心技能。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF menyenaraikan orientasi perkhidmatan dan khidmat pelanggan sebagai kemahiran teras yang dijangka kekal agak stabil.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF identifies quality control among skills expected to remain relatively stable.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 将质量控制列为预计保持相对稳定的技能。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF mengenal pasti kawalan kualiti sebagai kemahiran yang dijangka kekal agak stabil.

skill_signals.evidence: WEF reports a notable net decline; 24% of surveyed employers expect this skill group to decrease in importance.
skill_signals.evidence_zh: WEF 报告该技能组预计出现明显净下降；24% 的受访雇主预计其重要性会降低。
skill_signals.evidence_ms: WEF melaporkan penurunan bersih yang ketara; 24% majikan yang disurvei menjangka kepentingan kumpulan kemahiran ini menurun.
skill_signals.skill_zh: 手工灵巧度、耐力与精确度
skill_signals.skill_ms: Ketangkasan manual, daya tahan dan ketepatan

source_zh: 世界经济论坛《2025 年未来就业报告》——技能展望
source_ms: Forum Ekonomi Dunia, Laporan Future of Jobs 2025 — Outlook Kemahiran
